first_impression.reaction: Googled 'seminyak wedding venues' on the train. Second sentence tells me there are seven, five on the beach and two by a pool. Key Takeaways give me a guest range, jump links, then a table with a guest column and a grid by numbers right under it. That's the answer, fast. Still no idea what any of it costs. Bookmarked, won't enquire yet.

journey.quote: The Seminyak wedding venues worth a shortlist split into two groups: five resorts that sit on the beachfront, and two smaller addresses a few streets back, built around private pools.
journey.reaction: Answer in the first few lines. Seven venues, two types. Good.

journey.quote: Published wedding spaces run from a 16-guest hidden room at W Bali Seminyak to a deck that takes 300 for a reception, so match the space to your guest list before you fall for the view.
journey.reaction: Specific numbers straight away. A hidden 16-guest room sounds fun.
Handy on a phone. I can skip to the beach ones.

journey.section: Which Seminyak wedding venues are worth a look?
journey.quote: | Venue | Type | Setting | Ceremony options | Guests |
journey.reaction: Guests column is there, which is what I want. Five columns will still mean sideways scrolling on my phone.

journey.quote: Use this grid to narrow by numbers. Each figure is the venue's own, for the space named.
journey.reaction: This is the screenshot. Guest numbers to venue, and it's near the top. Done.

journey.quote: The pillarless Great Room has a Batu Alam stone wall, a spiral ceiling, Indian Ocean sunset views and a pre-function terrace; ask for its wedding capacity in writing.
journey.reaction: Long paragraph of room names in a single bullet. My eyes glazed over.

journey.quote: Not published: capacity, rooms, exclusive use.
journey.reaction: No ceremony option, no capacity. Why is it on a wedding venue list?

journey.section: Money and contracts: questions to ask each venue
journey.quote: Is there a minimum spend or venue hire fee, and are service charge and tax included?
journey.reaction: You're telling me to ask about money but never give me a rough number. Just tell me how much it costs.

journey.section: Security and privacy: questions for any couple
journey.quote: How loud are the neighbouring beach clubs at your ceremony and dinner times?
journey.reaction: Good question, but it's the fourth checklist in a row. I'm scrolling a lot now.

journey.section: How do guests get to Seminyak?
journey.quote: As at November 2026, travellers arriving at Indonesia's international entry points must complete an arrival card and apply for an e-Visa on Arrival, both on the All Indonesia website.
journey.reaction: Dated, which I like, but I searched for venues, not visas.

journey.section: When should you marry in Seminyak?
journey.quote: As at November 2026, Smartraveller says weather can change quickly during the wet season, usually around October to April.
journey.reaction: Dated and sourced, so I know it's current.

journey.quote: From 16 in W Bali Seminyak's 1 BELOW to 300 for a reception on its WET Deck.
journey.reaction: Short, direct answer to a question I'd actually type.

journey.section: Shortlist your Seminyak venues with a Wedded Advisor
journey.quote: Your Wedded Advisor is one person, start to finish, who works in your time zone and quotes in AUD for Australian couples.
journey.reaction: One person is nice. But 'for Australian couples', so is this for me in Singapore?

unanswered_questions: Roughly what does a wedding at any of these venues cost, even a starting package price? (none on the page)
Why these seven? What got a venue onto the list beyond hosting weddings?
Does Mrs Sippy Bali host ceremonies at all, or receptions only?
Do you work with couples who don't live in Australia? (deferred business detail)
How is the Wedded Concierge fee charged and roughly how much? (deferred business detail)

turn_offs_found.quote: Is there a minimum spend or venue hire fee, and are service charge and tax included?
turn_offs_found.why: The page raises cost several times but never gives a price, range or a plain line saying venues don't publish pricing, and cost is my obvious next question.

turn_offs_found.quote: The pillarless Great Room has a Batu Alam stone wall, a spiral ceiling, Indian Ocean sunset views and a pre-function terrace; ask for its wedding capacity in writing.
turn_offs_found.why: The W Bali reception bullet packs many space names and figures into one block that is hard to scan on a phone.

turn_offs_found.quote: How loud are the neighbouring beach clubs at your ceremony and dinner times?
turn_offs_found.why: Five checklists back to back, then visa, safety and legal sections, push the FAQ a long way down for someone who searched for venues.

would_share_with: My partner: a screenshot of the guest count grid and the Key Takeaways

cta_reaction.quote: When you are ready, [shortlist your Seminyak venues through Wedded Concierge](https://weddedwonderland.com/wonderland-concierge?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=seminyak-wedding-venues&utm_content=closing).
cta_reaction.why: Don't know the brand yet, no idea of cost, and the line before says AUD for Australian couples. Bookmark, not enquire.

top_3_changes: Add a cost FAQ, or one plain line saying none of the seven publishes wedding pricing, so the obvious next question is answered.
Split the W Bali reception bullet into shorter lines or lean on the grid instead, so it scans on a phone.
Say in one line why these seven made the list, and whether Mrs Sippy is a reception-only option.
